title: Aaj Daswa Naayebe Qairula Wara Paida Hua
body:
ho mubarak shaafie roze jaza paida hua
aaj daswa naayebe qairul wara paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
itrate at'haar ka choutha ali aali muqaam
ham sharaf ye hydere karrar ka paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hai naqi haadi wali jiske laqab wo shaahedee'n
jaanasheene murtaza salle alaa paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hai mohammad dekh kar rue pisar shaadaa'n bohot
hoobahu jo ham shabeehe murtaza paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
kya fazeelat ho baya'n daswe imaame paak ki
misle jadd badrud'doja shamsuzzoha paida hua
<<DIVIDER>>
hukm raane do jaha'n farma rawaae saamera
taajdaare dee'n imame do sara paida hua
